newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Usiminas still a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Usiminas still a buy.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers said it has reiterated its buy recommendation on Brazilian steelmaker Usiminas.
-- "Usiminas represents one of the best investment opportunities in the Brazilian flat steel industry," analysts M. Reveco and Pedro Martins Jr. wrote in a report.
-- The analysts cited Usiminas' first-quarter net profit of 70.8 million reais ($66.84 million), slightly above their projection of $59.5 million.
-- Crude steel production reached 1,003,000 tonnes, up slightly from last year's first quarter output of 1,001,000 tonnes, they said.
-- Net sales reached $403.9 million, 16.2 percent higher than first-quarter 1996 total sales and 13.5 percent higher than Salomon's projection for the period.
-- Gross profit reached $112.6 million, up 30 percent from the same period last year.
-- "For 1997 and 1998, we reconfirm our positive outlook for the company's net profit growth," the analysts said.
-- Usiminas' common was off 1.15 percent at 0.86 reais while its preferred share was off 0.83 percent at 1.19 reais at 1620 local/1920 GMT on the Sao Paulo bourse.
